▸ Tasks #/#                          Tasks — the panel with the keys
▶ ✓ implement-par… claude|opus-#  █    ↑↓                 move through the tasks
  ✗ implement-ren… codex|gpt-#-… !█    Enter              open the selected task in the panel
  ○ review-and-me… claude         █    F / L              follow the task's live transcript
                                       R                  restart a failed, blocked, cancelled or skipped task
                                       E                  edit an unfinished task (prompt, agent, model, limits)
                                       /                  search the task list

                                     Anywhere
                                       Tab / Shift+Tab    cycle the task list, the tabs, the panel and the footer
                                       Ctrl+P             command palette: every action and every task id
                                       ?                  the keys of whatever has focus
                                       Q                  quit: stay, stop and quit, or carry on in plain output
                                       Ctrl+C             stop the run and stay here; again within ##s forces it

                                     The task editor (E)
                                       ↑↓                 move between the fields; Enter on the last one goes to Save
                                       Ctrl+O             write the prompt in $VISUAL / $EDITOR
                                       Ctrl+J or \+Enter  a newline; both work on every terminal
                                       Enter              Save; a running or waiting task is asked about first
                                       Esc                close the form; nothing is sent

                                     Transcript viewer (F)
                                       ←→ / Tab / #-#     switch task    P task picker    [ ] earlier/later attempt
                                       ↑↓ PgUp/PgDn       scroll    g oldest line    G newest line and follow again
                                       t / T / k          tool output, thinking, kind filter
                                       / n N              search and step through matches
                                       Esc / Q            back to the workspace

                                     When a worker needs you
                                       Y / A / N / R      allow, allow for the rest of the task, deny, deny with a
                                                          reason
                                       #-# / ↑↓ Enter     choose an answer    T type one    N decline

                                     Moving around — the rest of the table
                                     ▼ # more   ↑↓ scroll   Esc close
